# Affordance adapter catalog

Regenerate with `python scripts/export_docs.py`.

| adapter | sources | private operations | denominator | completeness boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interface_exit` | `native_operation` | `close_active_interface` | The current observed blocking interface, when one exists. | Native cleanup covers Prospecting, dialogue, message boxes, trade and inventory windows, and ordinary registered GUI windows. |
| `runtime` | `runtime` | `consult_advisor`, `noop`, `pause`, `read_fieldbook`, `recall_memory`, `set_speed`, `stop`, `wait` | Runtime control, playback, advisor, memory, and fieldbook state. | Only choices applicable to the current run state. |
| `context_orders` | `context_order` | `perform_context_action` | Every exact world-target/order pair advertised by current telemetry. | Only the reviewed native natural-resource operate and squad-character first_aid subcases are emitted. Every other telemetry context action is withheld rather than routed through the retired pointer path. |
| `body_shift` | `nearby_character` | `shift_into_body` | Every exact current conscious, non-animal, non-hostile nearby character. | Native-assisted stable identity and nearby-character evidence; a body outside the reported radius cannot be offered and a hostile one is deliberately withheld. |
| `character_orders` | `nearby_character` | `perform_character_order` | Every order Kenshi currently advertises on every probed nearby person. | Bounded by the native probe budget: the nearest few people are asked what they afford, and the rest report that they were not asked. |
| `item_transfers` | `inventory` | `transfer_item` | Every item in every open inventory, offered into every other open inventory. | Uncapped across the currently exported open inventories. Native model capacity and simplified shop pricing are enforced at dispatch; Kenshi's richer trade and theft adjudication is not claimed. |
| `trade_windows` | `inventory` | `open_trade_window` | Every squadmate and reviewed natural resource, followed by a bounded stable subset of nearby people whose inventory could be paired with the selected character's. | Squadmates and reviewed resources are prioritized before the nearby-owner cap. Whether Kenshi pairs a given two is its answer at dispatch. |
| `dialogue_targets` | `dialogue` | `approach_dialogue_target` | Every exact current non-hostile character confirmed talkable. | Native-assisted stable identity and dialogue-role evidence. |
| `characters` | `composite_operation`, `nearby_character`, `squad` | `move_to_character`, `regroup_with_squad_member`, `respond_to_immediate_threat`, `select_squad_member_exact` | Every exact current squad member and eligible nearby character. | Offers require the source-specific selection, identity, geometry, and safety facts. |
| `map` | `map` | `travel_to_map_destination` | Every currently known exact map destination. | Only destinations with authoritative current travel applicability. |
| `native_and_composite` | `composite_operation`, `native_operation`, `visible_control` | `exit_current_building`, `move_in_direction`, `produce_resource_output`, `survey_local_resources` | Current state for native movement and bounded resource production. | Only operations with a current binder and declared runtime completion boundary. Resource production stops at observed output; transferring that output remains a separate inventory operation. |

The playing model sees runtime instances of this registry, not the
private operation kinds in the table. Every selection is rebound
against the same adapter before an operation is materialized.
